markets.rules_primary: If Each Yes contract pays $0.01 per PPR fantasy point scored by George Kittle during the San Francisco vs Atlanta Pro Football game originally scheduled for Oct 25, 2026 rounded to the nearest cent with half cents rounded up and limited to $0.00–$1.00. Each No contract pays $1.00 minus the Yes payout. Then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market uses Sleeper's weekly standard Points Per Reception (PPR) fantasy-point total for George Kittle during the San Francisco vs Atlanta Pro Football game originally scheduled for Oct 25, 2026.

This is a scalar market. The Yes payout per contract is $0.01 multiplied by the player's weekly fantasy points, rounded to the nearest $0.01 with $0.005 rounded up, and constrained to $0.00–$1.00. The No payout is $1.00 minus the rounded, constrained Yes payout. Payouts are proportional to the size of the holder's position. For example, 31.4 points pays Yes $0.31 and No $0.69; 32.5 points pays Yes $0.33 and No $0.67; negative points pay Yes $0.00 and No $1.00.

If Sleeper does not assign the player a fantasy-point figure for the specified week, the player is deemed to have scored 0.0 points. In that case, Yes pays $0.00 and No pays $1.00.
